assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster sprite sheet for Hotel Empire, a polished side-view hotel management game. Reference image is identity and rendering style only. Create FOUR distinct subtle IDLE WAITING poses of this exact guest, in one horizontal row of four equally spaced cells, all facing right in side view, full body visible. Same character, face, hair, outfit, bag and proportions in every frame. Feet planted on precisely the same baseline and head at same height. Poses: relaxed arms down; slight weight shift with one hand touching bag strap; looking slightly ahead patiently; relaxed return posture. Legs remain standing, never walking. Preserve warm hand-painted dimensional rendering, fine fabric/leather textures, clean readable silhouette, restrained warm lighting, professional game sprite finish. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no borders, no additional props. Wide 2:1 sheet, generous empty separation between figures and margins. Match source identity closely; do not copy its walking motion.
